properties.name: XMSS-SHA2_10_256 (Extended Merkle Signature Scheme)
properties.complexity_bounds: O(2^h) tree building, height h=10, 1024 signatures max per key pair
properties.algebraic_structure: WOTS+ Winternitz one-time signature chains over SHA-256 with tree hash evaluation
properties.security_category: NIST Post-Quantum Stateful Hash-Based Digital Signature Category 5

properties.name: Merkle Tree Hash Construction with Bitmasking
properties.complexity_bounds: Time: O(2^h) node hashes; Space: O(h) stack height during evaluation
properties.ring_modulus: GF(2^256) bitwise XOR with address-derived bitmasks before hashing
properties.algorithm_variant: L-tree and Binary Authentication Tree evaluation with RAND_HASH construction

properties.name: ARMv8.0-A Cryptographic Extension (FEAT_SHA256)
properties.throughput_bounds: 2 rounds of SHA-256 compression per SIMD instruction cycle

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Perform part 1 of 2 rounds of SHA-256 hash update using state in Qd, Qn, and message elements in Vm
Perform part 2 of 2 rounds of SHA-256 hash update using state in Qd, Qn, and message elements in Vm

properties.alignment_requirement: 16-byte boundary alignment for quadword vector access

properties.operation: Drives WOTS+ public key compression and Merkle authentication path construction

properties.vector_width: Parallel 4x 32-bit state updates executed per 128-bit vector instruction

properties.stage: First sub-step of two-round SHA-256 state update in Merkle node calculation
Second sub-step completing two rounds of SHA-256 compression

properties.access_pattern: Read/Write 128-bit register containing state variables A, B, C, D
Read/Write 128-bit register containing state variables E, F, G, H

evidence.reference: RFC 8391: XMSS: Extended Merkle Signature Scheme
